intent: Allow the Pre-commit checks workflow to be re-run manually, so a caching change can be verified on an unchanged tree instead of being asserted.
scope: Non-goal: changing what the job runs
changes: Added workflow_dispatch to the Pre-commit checks triggers.

verification.command: gh run view 32645759168 --log | grep for cache keys
verification.evidence: 'Cache not found for input keys: pre-commit-Linux-py3.12-...' then 'Cache saved with key: ...' -- the env cache missed because that commit changed .pre-commit-config.yaml, which is the key. It is populated now.
6 hook environments built from scratch, including pylint's with a dozen extra packages -- the bulk of the 126s hook step

verification.command: gh run view 32645759168 --log | grep 'pytest with coverage enforcement'
verification.evidence: '....Skipped' -- the duplicate-suite skip from the previous commit took effect

risks: A dispatch trigger lets anyone with write access run the job on demand; it runs the same read-only checks as a push, so there is no additional privilege.
rollback: After rollback, confirm the workflow no longer offers a Run workflow button.
